blocks.text: bind:value links an input to a state value. Typing changes that state and the parts of the page that read it.
Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.
Read the code step by step

items: `$state` marks a Svelte value as reactive so the page can follow its later changes.
`bind:value` connects a Svelte input value to state so typing and state changes stay in step.

blocks.text: The greeting changes as the person types.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep a label. Binding a value does not give an input an accessible name.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Type a name and clear the input.
